card.name: Researcher first names before surnames
card.fires_on: The first name or middle initial of a named researcher or doctor, just before the surname, in news-style or citation text. Examples are Vol|ker, Val|eri|ya, Anna H., and Dr Christine.

modes.label: Partway through first name
modes.description: Inside a longer given name that is split, with the surname still to come.

modes.label: Middle initial or period
modes.description: The initial or its period between a first name and the surname of a scientist.
modes.example: Anna H<<.>> Wu of the University of Southern California in

modes.label: Name after a title
modes.description: A first name right after Dr or a job title like physiologist.
modes.example: said Dr<< Christine>> Cole Johnson, from the Henry Ford Hospital

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated and the suppressed ones are equation terms.
card.plain: It fires on a scientist's first name or initial when the surname is about to follow.
